values.note: Electric sites, the only ones open to an RV or motorhome, $30 a night; the basic sites (pop-ups and tents only) $15 and the two Adirondack lean-tos $20. recreation.gov rate table for the 2026 and 2027 seasons, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233476/rates (2026-05-15..09-12 and 2027-05-21..09-11: STANDARD ELECTRIC $30, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $15, OVERNIGHT SHELTER $20) + per-site catalog (STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites permit only 'Pop up' and 'Tent'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 233476 (sites 01-11: Electricity Hookup 30 on nine, 15 on site 04; Water Hookup Y) + facility description ('11 campsites with electric and water hookups'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 233476 (11 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, Max Vehicle Length 40 ft on ten and 35 on site 08; 11 nonelectric sites 25 ft, pop-up/tent only; 2 lean-to shelters; every site Back-In) + facility description ('11 campsites with electric and water hookups, 11 basic sites without hookups and two Adirondack lean-to shelters'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233476 ('Amenities include accessible flush toilets and showers, and a dump station'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: No walk-ins at present (recreation.gov notice). 14 nights at most in any 30 days. The entrance gate is closed 9 p.m. to 8 a.m.; card payment only.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233476 (notices: 'Walk-ins are not currently allowed', 'There is a 14 day maximum stay within a 30 day period', 'Entrance gate is closed from 9pm - 8am', 'Cash is not accepted'; facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 nights rolling 30 days), read 2026-11-11

note: In pine and oak woods near West Thompson Lake, a Corps flood-control lake (5 mph limit, no swimming), with a boat ramp near the campground. Only the 11 electric sites take an RV; the basic sites are for tents and pop-ups. No alcohol. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: RV-usable sites are only the 11 electric ones ($30), so nightly_low 15 -> 30; 30A (one 15A) + water, 40 ft max, all back-in; flush toilets, showers, dump; no walk-ins, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max; not waterfront confirmed by rec.gov; season not written (only rate seasons published; USACE page unread).
flags: FIT: only the 11 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites (01-11) permit RV/Motorhome; their Max Vehicle Length is 40 ft (site 08: 35). The 11 nonelectric sites (12-22, 25 ft) permit only Pop up and Tent. So a 23-ft motorhome fits 11 sites, all at $30 - nightly_low raised from $15.
